$comment: Single source of truth for the repo label taxonomy. See .github/LABELS.md for the prose version. Consumed by scripts/apply-labels.ts.

labels.name: kind/bug
labels.description: Defect: behavior doesn't match documented or intended semantics.

labels.name: kind/feat
labels.description: New capability or expansion of existing capability.

labels.name: kind/design-q
labels.description: Design question requiring a decision before implementation; close + file feat/chore on resolution.

labels.name: kind/chore
labels.description: Maintenance, refactor, dependency bump, or other non-feature/non-bug work.

labels.name: kind/meta
labels.description: About the project or process itself (labels, conventions, governance).

labels.name: area/grammar
labels.description: Surface syntax: CRL + CEL lexer/parser/AST/transformer. See LABELS.md for directory map.

labels.name: area/corpus
labels.description: Shipped exemplars + corpus fixtures. See LABELS.md for directory map.

labels.name: area/docs
labels.description: User-facing docs (README.md, USER_GUIDE.md, docs/ non-spec content).

labels.name: area/repo
labels.description: The repo as a whole: .github/, CLAUDE.md, release process, label scheme, dev environment.

labels.name: priority/p0
labels.description: Critical — blocks shipping or causes data loss; must-fix.

labels.name: priority/p1
labels.description: High — significant impact; address in current release window.

labels.name: priority/p2
labels.description: Medium — should fix in a reasonable timeframe.
